control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$N" --check generation eq 1
control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N/runtime/reprovision" --expect 200 \
  --check runtime_status eq available --check can_resume eq true --check runtime_error eq null \
  --save F12.runtime-reprovision/reprovision

  --check runtime_status eq available
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N" --check execution_status eq idle
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$N/events/count" --check . eq "$EN"
control-agent-server state cat owner_lease.json --conversation "$N" --check generation eq 1
